IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_CopperM: The cauldron holds %1: fluids don't mix. Empty it first.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_NotOneF: A mix of fluids: only one plain fluid goes into the cauldron.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_NoFluid: You have nothing with a fluid in it.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_NoRoomI: You have no empty container, nor one holding the same fluid with room.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_EmptyCo: Pours away all %1 L of %2. There's no getting it back.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_HearthH: Pour a fluid into the cauldron and light the fire: it heats towards 95 C and steams at 85 C. Fill your own containers from it.
The fire is out: the cauldron cools. Add fuel and light it.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_BankHel: Rake the fire down under its ash: it burns a third of the wood, keeps the cauldron about 50 C, warms only the two tiles round it and cooks a third as fast.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_StokeHe: Rake the embers up into a full fire: the cauldron heats towards 95 C and the firebox cooks at full speed.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_HearthH: Banked: the embers burn a third of the wood, keep the cauldron about 50 C, warm only the two tiles round them and cook a third as fast. Stoke the fire to bring the cauldron to the steam.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_Firebox: The fire is out. Add fuel and light it: it cooks like an oven, a pot over the hole like a hob, and it warms what stands near it.
A full fire: it cooks like an oven, a pot over the hole like a hob, and its warmth reaches stations within 2 tiles. Bank it to make the wood last.
Banked: the embers burn a third of the wood, warm only the two tiles round them and cook a third as fast. Stoke it for a full fire.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_PlaceHe: By a fire, under a roof
By a fire, in the open
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_PlaceEm: By banked embers, under a roof
By banked embers, in the open
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_InfoFin: Finished and waiting to be taken: %1
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_InfoAss: Times left assume the temperature holds as it is now.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_TreatSp: It has spoiled: nothing saves it now.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_TreatSh: Not enough carried: %1 L takes %2 uses, you have %3.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_FlueFir: This Stone Hearth is already joined to something: disconnect it first
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_FlueCha: This Smokehouse already has a Stone Hearth joined to it
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_FlueDoo: The Stone Hearth can't stand at the Smokehouse's door end: put it by a long side or the back
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_FlueFir: The Stone Hearth's door faces it: anything joined leaves from its back or a flank
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_Connect: Remove what is fitted on the Stone Hearth first
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_FitBloc: What is joined to the Stone Hearth leaves no room: disconnect it first
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_FlueBur: Let the fire go out first
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_FluePip: A clay pipe out of the Stone Hearth's side, up past its top and into the Smokehouse wall, bedded in clay.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_FlueSto: A trench from the Stone Hearth's foot to the Smokehouse, roofed with flat stones on clay: a longer, cooler run for the smoke.
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_Disconn: Takes up the flue: %1 back, the clay is lost. Tool kept: %2
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_RemoveH: Takes it down: %1 back. Tool kept: %2
IGUI_TraditionalPreservationCore_FitCaul: Two metal pipes set in the stone either side of the hole, a heavy chain between them, the cauldron on a large hook in its middle. It holds 60 L of one fluid and brings it to the steam, or water to the boil. Fits whether or not a Smokehouse is joined.
